text.p: First Indiana Corp said Thursday its board voted a five-for-four stock split. It said the quarterly dividend will be paid on shares outstanding after the split, resulting in a seven percent dividend increase.
The split will be effective March 18 to holders of record as of March 3. Shareholders will receive one additional share of First Indiana stock for every four shares owned as of the record date.
Prior to the split, First Indiana had 8.8 million shares outstanding. It said after the split, that number will rise to 10,966,933.

First Indiana's quarterly cash payout for 1997 will be $0.12 per share, which is equivalent to an increase to $0.15 from $0.14 per share on pre-split shares. The cash dividend will be paid on March 18 on shares outstanding after the split to holders of record on March 6.
